channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Lambda now supports orchestrating MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions
item.description: Today, AWS announces a developer preview of a new extension for orchestrating Lambda MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions . The extension adds durable operations for running work on MicroVMs and managing their lifecycle. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni now integrates with PagerDuty
item.description: Amazon CloudWatch Omni alerts can now automatically create PagerDuty incidents, so notifications flow directly into your existing incident management workflows. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 M8g instances are now available in Israel (Tel Aviv)
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M8g instances are available in the Israel (Tel Aviv) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 M9gd instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Seoul)
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M9gd instances are available in the Asia Pacific (Seoul) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 C9gd instances now available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C9gd instances are available in the Europe (Ireland, Spain) regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 C9g instances are now available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C9g instances are available in the Asia Pacific (Sydney), Europe (Ireland, Spain), and South America (São Paulo) regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Recap of Microsoft Ignite 2026: Copilot as the Work OS and Agent Governance
item.description: At Ignite 2026, Microsoft positioned Copilot as the operating system for work and extended agent identity, governance, and cost controls across Azure, Foundry, Entra, and Defender. (1 source: infoq)
